server.title: PlyMove
server.description: Pedagogical chess intelligence for AI agents: explain positions and games for a target Elo.

serverInfo.name: PlyMove Storyboard
serverInfo.instructions: PlyMove builds Elo-aware chess game storyboards: opening context, story arc, ranked critical chapters, what-if branches, and a main lesson. Use build_game_storyboard for whole games. explain_game and find_teaching_moments are legacy aliases to the same storyboard flow. All tools are read-only analysis — they never modify user files, accounts, or external systems.
